definitions.rationale: This simplification equation defines the singleton-string case of strLt as integer-code comparison. Stage 1 separately proves the correspondence against MPY without VERIFICATION, so it is not a trusted DOMAIN_LEMMA; the required simplification-class constraint places it under DEFINITION.
definitions.text:
rule strLt(
         iCons(C:Int, .IntSeq),
         iCons(D:Int, .IntSeq))
    => C <Int D
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: This is a zero-argument macro expansion naming the exact translated AST of the inner insertion-loop body; it constructs syntax and does not execute or assert a mathematical fact.
definitions.text:
rule antiInnerBody()
    => If(
         BoolOp(
           "and",
           (UnaryOp("not", Name("inserted")),
            Compare(Name("char"), CmpOp("<", Name("old_char"))),
            .Exprs)),
         AugAssign(Name("new_word"), "+", Name("char"))
         Assign(Name("inserted"), Bool(true))
         .Stmts,
         .Stmts)
       AugAssign(Name("new_word"), "+", Name("old_char"))
       .Stmts

definitions.rationale: This is a zero-argument macro expansion naming the exact translated AST statements after the inner loop; it is a structural proof-term definition.
definitions.text:
rule antiPostInsert()
    => If(
         UnaryOp("not", Name("inserted")),
         AugAssign(Name("new_word"), "+", Name("char"))
         Assign(Name("inserted"), Bool(true))
         .Stmts,
         .Stmts)
       Assign(Name("word"), Name("new_word"))
       .Stmts

definitions.rationale: This rule expands antiOuterBody to the exact translated conditional and insertion-loop AST, making it a named syntax definition rather than an execution rule.
definitions.text:
rule antiOuterBody()
    => If(
         Compare(Name("char"), CmpOp("==", Str(" "))),
         AugAssign(Name("result"), "+", Name("word"))
         AugAssign(Name("result"), "+", Str(" "))
         Assign(Name("word"), Str(""))
         .Stmts,
         Assign(Name("new_word"), Str(""))
         Assign(Name("inserted"), Bool(false))
         For(Name("old_char"), Name("word"), antiInnerBody())
         antiPostInsert())
       .Stmts

definitions.rationale: This rule is the structural macro definition of the function tail AST containing the final append and return.
This is the empty-input recurrence equation for the mathematical insertion summary insertGo, returning the accumulator or appending the pending character according to the insertion flag.
definitions.text:
rule insertGo(.IntSeq, C:Int, A:IntSeq, B:Bool)
    => #if B
       #then A
       #else seqConcat(A, iCons(C, .IntSeq))
       #fi

definitions.rationale: This is the structurally recursive nonempty-input equation for insertGo; it consumes one old character and defines the summary's next accumulator and insertion flag.
definitions.text:
rule insertGo(
         iCons(OLD:Int, IS:IntSeq),
         C:Int,
         A:IntSeq,
         B:Bool)
    => #if notBool B andBool C <Int OLD
       #then insertGo(
               IS,
               C,
               seqConcat(
                 seqConcat(A, iCons(C, .IntSeq)),
                 iCons(OLD, .IntSeq)),
               true)
       #else insertGo(
               IS,
               C,
               seqConcat(A, iCons(OLD, .IntSeq)),
               B)
       #fi

definitions.rationale: This is the base recurrence equation for antiGo, defining the completed result when no input characters remain.
definitions.text:
rule antiGo(.IntSeq, R:IntSeq, W:IntSeq)
    => seqConcat(R, W)

definitions.rationale: This is the structurally recursive nonempty-input equation for antiGo, defining the space and non-space transitions while consuming one input character.
definitions.text:
rule antiGo(iCons(C:Int, S:IntSeq), R:IntSeq, W:IntSeq)
    => #if C ==Int 32
       #then antiGo(
               S,
               seqConcat(seqConcat(R, W), iCons(32, .IntSeq)),
               .IntSeq)
       #else antiGo(
               S,
               R,
               insertGo(W, C, .IntSeq, false))
       #fi
